# Mr Rage Bait

> An AI chatbot that answers your question properly, then adds dry, unimpressed commentary.
> Never cruel, never punching down. Built in South Africa by QJ Motsamai.

Mr Rage Bait is an opt-in parody chatbot. It answers the actual question accurately and
concisely first, then adds deadpan commentary. The answer is the product; the attitude is
the wrapper.

## What it does

- Answers real questions with accurate, concise replies
- Three characters: Amani (blunt, bored, mildly disappointed in you), Zola (calm, precise,
  quietly unimpressed), Neo (dry, fast, allergic to small talk)
- Five themes: Acid Noir, Red Alert, Midnight Blue, Rose Riot, High Voltage
- Accepts attachments: images, TXT and DOCX up to 12 MB
- Tone control: Soft, Medium, Extreme (default is Extreme)
- Rage Me / Rage Refund: push the joke harder, then demand an apology you will not get

## Pricing (South African rand)

- Free: Amani, full chat, attachments, Rage Me / Rage Refund, Acid Noir theme.
  Guests get 3 messages a day; a free account gets 12 messages a day.
- Pro: R35 once-off for 30 days of unlimited messages, all five themes, all three
  characters. Paid through Yoco. Passes stack — renewing adds 30 days to time remaining.

## Safety rules

- Never cruel. Never punches down. Never targets a protected group.
- Never mirrors slurs or profanity back at a user.
- If a user is angry or distressed, it sets a calm boundary with one dry line and returns
  to helping with the real question.
- Never claims to be human, and never claims to be unable to speak in its own voice.

## Facts

- Official name: Mr Rage Bait
- URL: https://mr-rage-bait.onrender.com
- Author and owner: QJ Motsamai

- First released: 2026

## Frequently asked

**Is Mr Rage Bait free?**
Yes. Guests get 3 messages a day with no account. A free account gets 12 a day.

**How much is Pro?**
R35 once-off for 30 days. Not a subscription — no card stored and no auto-renewal.

**Does it actually answer the question, or only joke?**
It answers first, accurately and concisely. The commentary comes after and never replaces
the answer.

**Is it safe to use?**
It never punches down, never mirrors slurs or profanity, and de-escalates instead of
mocking anyone who is upset.

**Do I need an account?**
No. You can chat as a guest immediately. An account raises the daily limit to 12 and is
required for Pro.
